dedupe_keys.name: open source python dynamic rms power system simulator for prototyping wide area monitoring control and protection applications ntnu

description: This record describes an open-source software package for dynamic RMS simulation of small to medium-sized power systems, written entirely in Python and presented in a 2021 arXiv paper by researchers at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology. Its objective is to make fast prototyping of new wide area monitoring, control and protection applications easy, by integrating with other Python tools for signal processing, artificial intelligence and communication protocols, so transparency and expandability are favoured over computational efficiency. The paper reports that the code is fast enough to emulate real-time simulation for small and medium grids with a 5 ms time step and allows interactive user feedback during simulation, and that it can be uploaded to an online Python interpreter, edited, run and shared through a browser. Coverage is small and medium-sized power systems. Access: the paper on arXiv, free; the abstract does not name the package or give a repository link or licence, so those need checking on the paper. Caveats: aimed at small and medium systems. It suits research prototyping of wide-area control, and relates to the ANDES simulator catalogued here.
